<translate>
'''Porunga''' is the Namek dragon. Gather the seven '''Namek Dragon Balls''' scattered around the world spawn of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]], place them together and right-click one to summon him. He grants '''three wishes''' per summon, chosen from the list below.
</translate>

<translate>
Because Porunga grants three wishes at once, he is the bigger prize, but you need a Namek radar and a trip off-world. A second Porunga, '''Porunga (Daima)''', can be summoned in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]] (see the last section of this page).
</translate>

<translate>
== Summoning Porunga ==
</translate>
{{Main|Dragons and Wishes}}
<translate>
Find the balls with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]] (Namek), crafted from a Radar's Chip (Namek) and a Radar's CPU (Namek). Shenron's ''Namekian Radar CPU'' wish gives four of those CPUs. Place all seven balls within 5 blocks of each other: once the set is complete the balls glow and chime, and right-clicking one summons Porunga. Only the player who summoned him can make the wishes.
</translate>

<translate>
While Porunga is out, the sky of Namek turns into a starry night sky (only visually). If nobody makes a wish, he leaves after 10 minutes. Either way, the balls scatter across Namek again.
</translate>

<translate>
== Wishes ==
</translate>
<translate>
Pick three wishes each time you summon Porunga. You can spend several of them on the same entry.
</translate>

{| class="wikitable"
! <translate>Wish</translate> !! <translate>What you get</translate>
|-
| <translate>Senzu Beans</translate> || <translate>32 [[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bean|Senzu Beans]].</translate>
|-
| <translate>Power Boost</translate> || <translate>×75 Attributes: half as Attribute Points and half as the Training Points those Attributes would cost you right now. Hover the wish in the wish screen to see the exact amounts.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Brave Sword</translate> || <translate>The [[Special:MyLanguage/Brave Sword|Brave Sword]], a special weapon.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Reset Passive</translate> || <translate>Clears your racial passive progress: Zenkai boosts and Power Release bonus, assimilations, absorptions and Cell Jrs. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Racial Skills|Racial Skills]].</translate>
|-
| <translate>Re-Customize Character</translate> || <translate>Reopens [[Special:MyLanguage/Character Customization|character customization]]. You can change your appearance and class, but not your race. Your stats and skills are kept.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Reallocate Stats</translate> || <translate>Resets your attributes to their class base and gives you Attribute Points equal to every stat point you had spent, so you can redistribute them in the stats menu. Training Points are not refunded.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Change Difficulty</translate> || <translate>Lets you choose your story difficulty again the next time you open the Quest Tree, without resetting your saga progress.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Reset Story Progress</translate> || <translate>Wipes your quest progress across every saga and side quest, so you can play the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|sagas]] again. Your difficulty is kept.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Bring someone back to life!</translate> || <translate>Truly revives 1 dead player of your choice. You can pick it more than once in the same summon.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Armor Materials</translate> || <translate>64 Kikono Shards and 128 Iron Ingots.</translate>
|-
| <translate>Invincible Armor</translate> || <translate>The Invincible [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor|armor]] set (helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots).</translate>
|-

|-

|-
| <translate>Potara Earrings (Green)</translate> || <translate>A '''Pair of Green Pothalas''', split the same way.</translate>

<translate>
== Notes ==
</translate>
<translate>
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Shining Sword Attack|Shining Sword Attack]] technique can only be used while holding the Brave Sword.
* Each pair of Potara earrings has its own pair ID: the two players must wear the left and the right earring of the same pair.
* The revive wish only works on players who are dead in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]] and online. Revived players lose their halo and are fully alive again.
* After a '''Reset Story Progress''', story rewards shrink on every new run (by default 50% on the second run, 25% on the third, and so on).
* The [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] quest ''Summon Porunga'' asks you to summon him with the Namek Dragon Balls.
</translate>

<translate>
== Porunga (Daima) ==
</translate>
<translate>
'''Porunga (Daima)''' is a second Porunga who lives in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. He offers the same wish list as Porunga, with three wishes per summon.
</translate>

<translate>
He is summoned with the three '''Demon Realm Dragon Balls''' (one, two and three stars). These balls are never scattered around the world and no radar finds them: each Tamagami world boss drops its own ball when defeated ([[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Number 3|Tamagami Number 3]] the three-star ball, [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Number 2|Tamagami Number 2]] the two-star ball and [[Special:MyLanguage/Tamagami Number 1|Tamagami Number 1]] the one-star ball). Place the three balls within 5 blocks of each other in the Demon Realm and right-click one to summon him. The balls don't scatter after the wish, so you need to defeat the Tamagamis again for a new set.
</translate>
